list_transcriptions.title: List batch transcriptions
list_transcriptions.description: Page through the batch transcription jobs on this resource, newest first, each with its status (NotStarted, Running, Succeeded, Failed) and the locale and model it used. Narrow with an OData filter such as "status eq 'Failed'".

skip.description: How many transcriptions to skip, for paging.

top.description: How many transcriptions to return per page.

filter.description: OData filter, e.g. "status eq 'Succeeded'" or "createdDateTime gt 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z".

output.description: A page of transcription jobs.

values.description: Each with self, displayName, status, locale, createdDateTime and links.

@nextLink.description: Absolute url of the next page; absent on the last.

create_transcription.title: Start a batch transcription
create_transcription.description: Transcribe recorded audio that already sits at a URL -- give content_urls for individual files, or content_container_url for a SAS-signed blob container to transcribe wholesale. Returns immediately with a job whose self link ends in the id; poll get_transcription until status is Succeeded, then read the results with list_transcription_files. properties is where diarisation, profanity filtering, word-level timestamps and destination container go.

display_name.description: Name for the job, shown when listing.

locale.description: Language of the audio, e.g. en-US, en-GB, de-DE.

content_urls.description: URLs of the audio files to transcribe. Give this or content_container_url.

content_container_url.description: SAS URL of a blob container whose audio files should all be transcribed.

model.description: Custom Speech model to use, as an object with a self link, e.g. {"self": ".../models/<id>"}. Omit for the default base model.

properties.description: Job options -- diarizationEnabled, wordLevelTimestampsEnabled, punctuationMode, profanityFilterMode, destinationContainerUrl, languageIdentification and timeToLive.

custom_properties.description: Your own key/value metadata, echoed back on the job.

output.description: The created job, whose self link carries the transcription id.

links.description: files link, once the job succeeds.

get_transcription.title: Get a batch transcription
get_transcription.description: Read one transcription job's current status and settings. status is NotStarted, Running, Succeeded or Failed; on failure, properties.error says why. Once Succeeded, call list_transcription_files for the results.

transcription_id.description: Id of the transcription, the last segment of its self link.

output.description: The job, with its status, locale, model and any error.

update_transcription.title: Rename or annotate a transcription
update_transcription.description: Change a transcription job's display name, description or custom properties. The audio, locale and model of a submitted job cannot be changed -- create a new job for that.

transcription_id.description: Id of the transcription to update.

custom_properties.description: Replacement key/value metadata for the job.

output.description: The job as stored after the update.

delete_transcription.title: Delete a batch transcription
delete_transcription.description: Remove a transcription job and its result files from the service. The source audio is untouched, but the transcripts are gone unless the job wrote them to your own destination container.

transcription_id.description: Id of the transcription to delete.

output.description: Empty on success -- the service answers 204 No Content.

list_transcription_files.title: List a transcription's result files
list_transcription_files.description: List the output files of a completed transcription. Each entry has a kind (Transcription for the per-audio JSON result, TranscriptionReport for the run summary) and a links.contentUrl holding a short-lived SAS URL to download it. Only available once status is Succeeded.

skip.description: How many files to skip, for paging.

top.description: How many files to return per page.

sas_validity_in_seconds.description: How long the returned download URLs stay valid.

output.description: The result files, each with a temporary download URL.

values.description: Each with kind, name, createdDateTime and links.contentUrl.

list_supported_locales.title: List locales supported for transcription
list_supported_locales.description: List the language codes batch transcription accepts, so a locale can be validated before a job is submitted rather than after it fails.

output.description: The supported locale codes.

items.description: A BCP-47 locale such as en-GB.

list_base_models.title: List base speech models
list_base_models.description: List the Microsoft-provided speech recognition models available in this region, with the locale and features each supports and when it is retired. A base model is what a transcription uses when no custom model is named, and what a custom model is trained from.

skip.description: How many models to skip, for paging.

top.description: How many models to return per page.

output.description: A page of base models.

values.description: Each with self, displayName, locale, properties and deprecationDates.

get_base_model.title: Get a base speech model
get_base_model.description: Read one base model's details -- its locale, the features it supports, the datasets it may be adapted with, and the dates adaptation and transcription support end.

model_id.description: Id of the base model, the last segment of its self link.

output.description: The base model's details.

list_custom_models.title: List custom speech models
list_custom_models.description: List the Custom Speech models trained on this resource, with the base model each adapted and its current status. Use one of these in create_transcription to improve accuracy on domain vocabulary.

skip.description: How many models to skip, for paging.

top.description: How many models to return per page.

filter.description: OData filter over the models, e.g. "locale eq 'en-US'".

output.description: A page of custom models.

values.description: Each with self, displayName, baseModel, locale and status.

create_custom_model.title: Train a custom speech model
create_custom_model.description: Adapt a base model to your domain using datasets already uploaded to the resource -- plain text for vocabulary, or audio plus transcripts for acoustic adaptation. Training is asynchronous: poll get_custom_model until status is Succeeded.

display_name.description: Name for the model, shown when listing.

locale.description: Language the model recognises, e.g. en-GB.

datasets.description: The datasets to train from, each an object with a self link, e.g. [{"self": ".../datasets/<id>"}].

base_model.description: Base model to adapt, as {"self": ".../models/base/<id>"}. Omit for the region default.

project.description: Project to file the model under, as {"self": ".../projects/<id>"}.

properties.description: Training options, e.g. {"emailAddress": "..."} to be notified when it finishes.

custom_properties.description: Your own key/value metadata, echoed back on the model.

output.description: The model being trained, whose self link carries its id.

get_custom_model.title: Get a custom speech model
get_custom_model.description: Read one custom model's status, the base model it adapted, the datasets it trained on and its deprecation dates. Poll this after create_custom_model until status is Succeeded.

output.description: The custom model's details and training status.

delete_custom_model.title: Delete a custom speech model
delete_custom_model.description: Remove a custom model. Any endpoint still deployed with it stops working, and the model cannot be recovered without retraining, so check list_endpoints first.

model_id.description: Id of the custom model to delete.

output.description: Empty on success -- the service answers 204 No Content.

list_projects.title: List Custom Speech projects
list_projects.description: List the projects on this resource. A project groups the datasets, models, evaluations and endpoints for one Custom Speech effort, which is how Speech Studio organises them.

skip.description: How many projects to skip, for paging.

top.description: How many projects to return per page.

output.description: A page of projects.

values.description: Each with self, displayName, locale and createdDateTime.

create_project.title: Create a Custom Speech project
create_project.description: Create a project to group datasets, models, evaluations and endpoints for one locale. Projects are organisational only -- nothing requires one, but Speech Studio shows work through them.

locale.description: Language the project works in, e.g. en-GB.

custom_properties.description: Your own key/value metadata for the project.

output.description: The created project, whose self link carries its id.

get_project.title: Get a Custom Speech project
get_project.description: Read one project's metadata and the links to the datasets, models, evaluations and endpoints filed under it.

output.description: The project and links to the resources it groups.

delete_project.title: Delete a Custom Speech project
delete_project.description: Delete a project along with the datasets, models, evaluations and endpoints filed under it. This cascades, so confirm what the project holds with get_project before calling it.

project_id.description: Id of the project to delete.

output.description: Empty on success -- the service answers 204 No Content.

list_datasets.title: List Custom Speech datasets
list_datasets.description: List the training and testing datasets uploaded to this resource, each with its kind (Language, Acoustic, Pronunciation, AudioFiles) and processing status.

skip.description: How many datasets to skip, for paging.

top.description: How many datasets to return per page.

output.description: A page of datasets.

values.description: Each with self, kind, displayName, locale and status.

create_dataset.title: Register a Custom Speech dataset
create_dataset.description: Register training or testing data that already sits at a URL, so a custom model can be trained from it. kind picks what the data is -- Language for a plain-text vocabulary file, Acoustic for audio with transcripts, Pronunciation for a pronunciation file, AudioFiles for audio alone. Import is asynchronous; poll get_dataset until status is Succeeded.

kind.description: What the data is, which decides how it may be used in training.

locale.description: Language of the data, e.g. en-GB.

content_url.description: SAS-signed URL of the data file or zip archive to import.

project.description: Project to file the dataset under, as {"self": ".../projects/<id>"}.

custom_properties.description: Your own key/value metadata for the dataset.

output.description: The dataset being imported, whose self link carries its id.

get_dataset.title: Get a Custom Speech dataset
get_dataset.description: Read one dataset's kind, locale and import status. Poll after create_dataset until status is Succeeded; on failure, properties.error explains what the import rejected.

output.description: The dataset's details and import status.

delete_dataset.title: Delete a Custom Speech dataset
delete_dataset.description: Remove a dataset from the resource. Models already trained from it keep working; the data itself is no longer available for future training.

dataset_id.description: Id of the dataset to delete.

output.description: Empty on success -- the service answers 204 No Content.

list_dataset_files.title: List a dataset's files
list_dataset_files.description: List the files that make up a dataset, each with a short-lived SAS URL to download it -- including the report the service produced while importing, which is where import warnings live.

skip.description: How many files to skip, for paging.

top.description: How many files to return per page.

sas_validity_in_seconds.description: How long the returned download URLs stay valid.

output.description: The dataset's files, each with a temporary download URL.

values.description: Each with kind, name and links.contentUrl.

list_endpoints.title: List custom speech endpoints
list_endpoints.description: List the deployed Custom Speech endpoints on this resource, each with the model it serves and its status. An endpoint is what real-time recognition clients address when they want a custom model rather than the base one.

skip.description: How many endpoints to skip, for paging.

top.description: How many endpoints to return per page.

output.description: A page of deployed endpoints.

values.description: Each with self, displayName, model, locale and status.

create_endpoint.title: Deploy a custom speech endpoint
create_endpoint.description: Deploy a custom model so real-time recognition clients can use it. Deployment takes some minutes -- poll get_endpoint until status is Succeeded, then read properties for the endpoint key and id the SDKs need.

locale.description: Language the endpoint recognises, e.g. en-GB.

project.description: Project to file the endpoint under, as {"self": ".../projects/<id>"}.

properties.description: Deployment options, e.g. {"loggingEnabled": true} to keep audio and transcripts.

custom_properties.description: Your own key/value metadata for the endpoint.

output.description: The endpoint being deployed, whose self link carries its id.

get_endpoint.title: Get a custom speech endpoint
get_endpoint.description: Read one endpoint's status, the model it serves and its logging settings. Poll this after create_endpoint until status is Succeeded.

output.description: The endpoint's details and deployment status.

delete_endpoint.title: Delete a custom speech endpoint
delete_endpoint.description: Undeploy an endpoint. Any client still addressing its endpoint id stops recognising immediately; the model and datasets behind it are untouched.

endpoint_id.description: Id of the endpoint to delete.

output.description: Empty on success -- the service answers 204 No Content.

list_evaluations.title: List model evaluations
list_evaluations.description: List the accuracy evaluations run on this resource. An evaluation transcribes a test dataset with one or two models and reports the word error rate, which is how you tell whether a custom model actually beats the base one.

skip.description: How many evaluations to skip, for paging.

top.description: How many evaluations to return per page.

output.description: A page of evaluations.

values.description: Each with self, displayName, status and the models compared.

create_evaluation.title: Evaluate speech models against a test set
create_evaluation.description: Compare one or two models on a labelled test dataset and get word error rates back. Give model1 and model2 as objects with self links (use the same link twice to score a single model). Asynchronous -- poll get_evaluation until status is Succeeded.

locale.description: Language of the test data, e.g. en-GB.

model2.description: Second model to compare against. Pass the same link as model1 to score one model.

project.description: Project to file the evaluation under, as {"self": ".../projects/<id>"}.

custom_properties.description: Your own key/value metadata for the evaluation.

output.description: The evaluation being run, whose self link carries its id.

get_evaluation.title: Get a model evaluation
get_evaluation.description: Read an evaluation's status and, once Succeeded, its word error rate breakdown -- insertions, deletions and substitutions for each model compared.

output.description: The evaluation's status and error rate results.

properties.description: wordErrorRate1, wordErrorRate2 and the counts behind them.

delete_evaluation.title: Delete a model evaluation
delete_evaluation.description: Remove an evaluation and its result files. The models and test dataset it compared are untouched.

evaluation_id.description: Id of the evaluation to delete.

output.description: Empty on success -- the service answers 204 No Content.

get_health_status.title: Check the Speech service's health
get_health_status.description: Report the health of the speech-to-text service in this region. A useful first call when transcriptions are failing, to separate a service problem from a problem with the job.

output.description: Overall health and per-component status for the region.

list_batch_syntheses.title: List batch synthesis jobs
list_batch_syntheses.description: List the long-form text-to-speech jobs on this resource, each with its status and the audio it produced. Batch synthesis is for material too long for a single synthesize_speech call -- audiobooks, whole articles.

skip.description: How many jobs to skip, for paging.

max_page_size.description: How many jobs to return per page.

api_version.description: Batch synthesis API version to call.

output.description: A page of batch synthesis jobs.

value.description: Each with id, status, createdDateTime and outputs.

create_batch_synthesis.title: Start a batch synthesis job
create_batch_synthesis.description: Synthesise long-form audio asynchronously. You choose the job id, so the call is idempotent -- a repeat with the same id returns the existing job rather than starting a second one. input_kind is PlainText or SSML, and inputs is a list of {"content": "..."} blocks. Poll get_batch_synthesis until status is Succeeded, then download from outputs.result.

synthesis_id.description: An id you choose for the job. Reusing one returns the existing job.

inputs.description: The text blocks to synthesise, each an object with content, e.g. [{"content": "Hello."}].

example.content: It was a bright cold day in April.

input_kind.description: Whether inputs hold plain text or SSML markup.

synthesis_config.description: Voice settings for PlainText input, e.g. {"voice": "en-GB-SoniaNeural"}.

properties.description: Job options -- outputFormat, wordBoundaryEnabled, concatenateResult, destinationContainerUrl.

custom_voices.description: Map of custom voice name to deployment id, when using your own voices.

api_version.description: Batch synthesis API version to call.

output.description: The job as created, with its id and initial status.

get_batch_synthesis.title: Get a batch synthesis job
get_batch_synthesis.description: Read one batch synthesis job's status and, once Succeeded, the URLs of the audio, summary and word-boundary files it produced. Those URLs are short-lived, so download promptly.

synthesis_id.description: Id of the batch synthesis job.

api_version.description: Batch synthesis API version to call.

output.description: The job's status and output file URLs.

outputs.description: result, summary and, when enabled, wordBoundary URLs.

delete_batch_synthesis.title: Delete a batch synthesis job
delete_batch_synthesis.description: Remove a batch synthesis job and the audio it produced. Download anything you need from outputs first -- after this the files are gone.

synthesis_id.description: Id of the batch synthesis job to delete.

api_version.description: Batch synthesis API version to call.

output.description: Empty on success -- the service answers 204 No Content.

list_voices.title: List available speech voices
list_voices.description: List every neural voice available in this region, with its short name (en-GB-SoniaNeural), locale, gender, the styles and roles it supports and whether it can whisper or sing. Use the ShortName from here as the voice in synthesize_speech. Served from the region's TTS host rather than the Cognitive Services endpoint.

output.description: Every voice available in the region.

items.description: Name, ShortName, DisplayName, Locale, Gender, VoiceType, StyleList and RolePlayList.

synthesize_speech.title: Synthesise speech from SSML
synthesize_speech.description: Turn SSML into audio and return the audio bytes. The body is SSML, not plain text -- wrap the words in <speak> with a <voice name="..."> naming a voice from list_voices. output_format picks the codec and sample rate, e.g. audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3 or riff-24khz-16bit-mono-pcm. Limits are 10 minutes of audio and 64 KB of SSML per call; use create_batch_synthesis for anything longer. Served from the region's TTS host rather than the Cognitive Services endpoint.

ssml.description: The SSML document to speak, e.g. <speak version='1.0' xml:lang='en-GB'><voice name='en-GB-SoniaNeural'>Hello.</voice></speak>

output_format.description: Audio codec and sample rate to return, from the service's output format list.

output.description: The synthesised audio, as bytes in the requested format.

issue_auth_token.title: Exchange the key for a bearer token
issue_auth_token.description: Trade the subscription key for a bearer token valid for ten minutes. The Speech SDKs and the real-time WebSocket endpoints take this token rather than the key, so this is the call to make before handing credentials to a client that should not hold the key itself.

output.description: The bearer token, as a plain-text JWT valid for ten minutes.
